description: Read a contact's sanctions coverage per list and a bounded cursor page of current matches. Follow matches.nextCursor until null; matches.items contains evidence, review disposition and reviewTarget. Unavailable never means clear. Binding versus informational uses the firm's practice jurisdictions. To review a current match, call contacts.sanctions.reviews.update with its reviewTarget, a dismissed or confirmed disposition and a reason.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page to fetch the next page
